paragraphs.text: Native Astra recovered from an unavailable Python command and a patch that tried to delete and add the same path. It generated the implementation again through the shell, added tests, and completed in 159.9 seconds.
The unchanged program passed all five acceptance groups and all three additional graph and scale checks. Open Files to inspect the implementation, or Tests for the exact results.

explanation.title: Read together. Review once. Keep the exact edit.

paragraphs.text: Astra read the source, configuration and tests together. The factory retained the proposed rewrite, and Astra accepted it with a 92-character confirmation receipt.

Astra then revised its CLI entry-point check with a two-edit patch, added behavioral and CLI tests, ran them, and delivered the result. The unchanged program passed all five acceptance groups and all three additional graph and scale checks.
